name: studioforge-creator-os
description: StudioForge - Mobile Creator OS for Video Production

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html','www/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('styles.css','www/styles.css'); if(fs.existsSync('version.json')) fs.copyFileSync('version.json','www/version.json'); if(fs.existsSync('mqtt.min.js')) fs.copyFileSync('mqtt.min.js','www/mqtt.min.js');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:run: npm run build && npx cap sync && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:open: npm run build && npx cap sync && npx cap open android
scripts.patch:build: npm run build && powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path 'patches')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'patches' }; Compress-Archive -Path 'www\*' -DestinationPath ('patches\patch-v' + (Get-Content version.json | ConvertFrom-Json).version + '.zip') -Force; Write-Host 'Patch zip generated in patches/ directory!'"
